notes.title: Grit: Overworld Survival goes on sale today!
notes.notes:
I would just like to give an an enormous thank you to reddit's r/roguelikes community for encouraging me and helping with testing and ideas along the way, could not have done it without you guys and gals.  

Enjoy the game at a steep launch of %33 :), at 1.99 I hope everyone will have a chance to experience the misery of survival by themselves.   

All comments and suggestions are welcome, Mac and Linux builds are coming soon!

notes.title: Welcome to the Grit community!
notes.notes:
[b]Holla back at this post and I'll send you a free key once the game is released![/b]

A big thank you to Steam for passing the submission so quickly, and another huge thank you to the reddit community, could not have done this without you.
I'll release the PC version in about 2 weeks from now, but Mac and Linux will follow soon after.  Speaking of Linux, I need someone who could test builds for me as I'm not too familiar with that system, will provide free code in exchange. 

Thank you all and will see you at the release party :)
